page.overview:
Who is Sam?

Sam was a small time robber along with his friend.

Nothing is known about Sam's life, except he was a small time crook working for an unknown boss, and had a friend.

In Midnight City, Sam and his accomplice tries try breaking into a building. When he manage to open a door with a crowbar, his accomplice mutters about Darkwing.

Sam tells his friend not to worry about Darkwing and that he can't be everywhere. Sam's Friend points his finger at Darkwing. Sam tries to hit Darkwing with the crowbar, gets punched and Darkwing puts Magnetic handcuffs on his hands which pulls him to the water tanks. Darkwing also catches his accomplice and tells them that he knows what's in the building they want to rob known, and who wants what is there. He asks them about their boss and Sam replies to Darkwing asking if they look like rats to him.
